comment: Ratchet guardrail against silent complexity drift — advisory only, never
blocks CI or merge. Exceeding a ceiling prints a visible notice alongside
the architecture check output. If a change genuinely needs to grow a file,
raise the number here in the SAME pull request: that keeps growth a
conscious, visible, reviewed decision instead of silent drift.
Lowering these numbers is not an acceptance goal. Do not split a file only
to reduce maxLines. Prefer a narrower command surface and exclusive view
states over another mechanical file cut.
Only files with a demonstrated regrowth risk are listed; this is
deliberately not applied to every large file.
Metrics: maxLines = physical line count; maxHooks = total React hook calls
applies to React modules; a non-React file lists maxLines alone.
See docs/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md > Architecture gate assertion forms.
